title: Under-specified: parametric screw bin
prompt: I need a small box to keep screws in, about hand-sized, with rounded corners. I'll want to resize it later.

hidden_tests.description: The model evaluates without feature or parameter errors
Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Hand-sized: fits within 200 × 150 × 80 mm and is at least 40 × 30 × 15
A hollow, open box (inside and outside faces), not a solid block
The defaults became parameters: at least three length parameters (e.g. width, depth, height)

questions: Roughly what outside size, or how many screws of which size should it hold?
Do you want a lid, dividers or stacking features?
What wall thickness and corner radius?
clarify.assumptions: 90 × 60 × 40 mm outside, R8 corners, 2 mm walls and floor, open top, no dividers; width, depth, height, corner radius and wall are parameters.
